title: Deleting a vertex from a cuttable multigraph
statement: Let $G$ be a multigraph that admits a cut. Then for every vertex $v$, the vertex set of $G$ with $v$ removed, $V(G) \setminus \{v\}$, is nonempty.
replaced:
If $G$ admits a cut $C$, then for every vertex $v$ the set $V(G) \setminus \{v\}$ is
nonempty, since both sides of $C$ are nonempty.
